verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (logo, sale ribbon, phone, headline, offer, CTA, legal), but the headline breaks into five lines of mostly one word each ('the', 'day', 'last') and crowds the space, so the CTA and legal text are squeezed against the bottom edge with the logo barely visible. B wraps the headline better, but it moves the 'LONGEST DAY SALE' ribbon to the bottom, tiny and below the CTA, which kills the main promo hook. It also puts the legal text above the CTA (wrong reading order) and pushes the logo into the top-right corner, where it almost disappears.
